Cultist Sacrifice.text: Target an enemy NPC and consume it for 170% Bonus Souls and grants a powerful long lasting buff.

Tesla Bullets.text: Your bullets have a chance to shock your target. The shock will jump to a nearby enemy.

Capacitor.text: Your bullets have a chance to shock your target. The shock will jump to a nearby enemy.

Hollow Point.text: When you are above 65% health, deal additional Weapon Damage and your bullets reduce enemy Bullet Resist.

Opening Rounds.text: Your attacks have additional Weapon Damage against enemies above 50% health.

Melee Lifesteal.text:
Your next Melee attack heals you.

This heal is 30% effective vs non-heroes.
Cooldown is 1.5x as long for Light Melee hits.

Rebuttal.text: On a successful Parry against an enemy Hero, Heal yourself for the damage parried and returns that damage to the target, and temporarily gain increased damage.

Weighted Shots.text: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.

Close Quarters.text: Deal additional Weapon Damage when in close range to your target.

Long Range.text: Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.

Slowing Bullets.text: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.

Inhibitor.text: Your bullets build up to reduce the target's outgoing damage and apply healing reduction.

Spirit Shredder.text: Your bullets apply a debuff that reduces the Spirit Resist of the target and grants you and your allies Spirit Lifesteal against them.

Heroic Aura.text: Provides Bullet Resist to nearby friendly units.

Silence Wave.text:
Launch an expanding projectile which Silences enemies for a short duration and deals impact damage.

Silence does not interrupt channeling abilities.

Silencer.text: For the next 4s, all your bullets immediately apply Silence. Silence prevents targets from using abilities.

Berserker.text: Your Weapon Damage increases as you take sustained damage.

Frenzy.text: While you are below 50% health, you gain stat bonuses for a duration and existing debuffs on you are reduced.

Siphon Bullets.text: Your bullets temporarily steal Max HP from enemies. Enemies regain their stolen health when the debuff expires.

Weakening Headshot.text: Landing a Headshot reduces their Bullet Resist.

Sharpshooter.text: Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.

Spirit Rend.text: Your bullets apply a debuff that reduces the Spirit Resist of the target and grants you and your allies Spirit Lifesteal against them.
Landing headshots against the target reduces their Spirit Resist further.

Crippling Headshot.text: Landing a Headshot will reduce their Bullet, Spirit Resist, and Incoming Healing.

Lucky Shot.text:
Your bullets have a chance to be empowered, causing them to deal bonus weapon damage on hit.
Bonus damage cannot Crit.

Point Blank.text: When in close range to your target, gain Weapon Damage and your bullets apply a Movement Slow.

Toxic Bullets.text: Your bullets build up a Bleed on enemies, causing them to lose a percentage of their Max Health over time. Also reduces Incoming Healing on the bleeding target.

Ricochet.text: Your bullets will ricochet on enemies near your target, applying any bullet procs and dealing a percentage of the original damage.

Debuff Reducer.text: Reduces the duration of all negative effects applied to you.

Dispel Magic.text:
Purge all non-ultimate negative effects currently applied to you. If any effects were removed, heal yourself and gain a move speed bonus.
Cannot be used while Stunned or Slept.

Spirit Resilience.text: When below 50% health, gain additional Spirit Resist.

Bullet Resilience.text: When below 50% health, gain additional Bullet Resist.

Healing Booster.text: Increases the effectiveness of your healing.

Fortitude.text: After not taking damage for a period, gain health regen.
When you are above 75% health, you have bonus Move Speed.

Trophy Collector.text: Whenever you score an assist or kill, gain extra sprint, ability range and passive soul generation. This effect stacks and persists through death.

Enduring Speed.text: Reduces the effect of enemy Move Speed penalties.

Stamina Mastery.text: Allows an additional use of Air Jump or Air Dash before landing.

Hunter's Aura.text: Reduces nearby enemies' Bullet Resist and Fire Rate. If there is only one enemy hero nearby, this effect is doubled.

Grit.text: Gain a Barrier for a short duration.

Spiritual Overflow.text: Gain bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Spirit Lifesteal by charging up when shooting heroes.

Return Fire.text: Automatically fire a bullet towards any attacker who damages you with their abilities or weapon.

Greater Expansion.text: Increases the range and effect radius of your abilities and items.

Mystic Expansion.text: Imbue an ability to increase its range and effect radius.

stats.label: Bonus Spirit Power for Charged Abilities

Mystic Reverb.text: Imbue an ability with Lifesteal and to apply slow on a hit target and deal an additional percentage of the damage dealt to enemies around the target after a short delay.

stats.label: Bonus Spirit Power for Charged Abilities
Bonus Spirit Power for Charged Abilities

Omnicharge Signet.text: Imbue any active non-ultimate ability with Bonus Ability Charges. Already charged abilities receive more bonus charges.

Compress Cooldown.text: Imbue an ability to reduce its Cooldown.

Superior Cooldown.text: Reduces the Cooldown of your abilities.

Transcendent Cooldown.text: Reduces the Cooldown of your abilities and items.

Slowing Hex.text:
Slows movement of enemy target. Also Silences their movement-based items and abilities.
Increases the target's gravity.
Does not affect target's stamina usage.

Spirit Sap.text: Target an enemy to reduce their Spirit Resist and Spirit Power.

Focus Lens.text: Target an enemy to Silence them. A portion of all damage dealt during the silence gets applied to the target when the silence wears off.

Rusted Barrel.text: Target an enemy to reduce their Fire Rate and Bullet Resistance.

Disarming Hex.text: Disarms enemy target and reduces their Bullet Resist.

Rescue Beam.text: Heals a target allied hero and yourself for a percentage of Max Health. Once while healing, you can Pull the target towards you. Can be self-cast.

Decay.text:
Inflict damage over time to a target, dealing damage based on their current health.
Decay's damage is non-lethal and does not apply item procs.

Knockdown.text:
Apply a Stun after 2s. Stun duration is increased against airborne targets.

Increases the target's gravity for the duration of the stun.

Phantom Strike.text: Teleport to an enemy target and pull them to the ground. Dealing damage, Move speed reduction and Disarm.

Warp Stone.text: Teleport straight ahead, gaining Bullet Resist.

Vortex Web.text:
Throw a vacuum grenade, pulling all enemies into a small area and applying Slowing Hex.

Alt Cast to Target Unit Directly.

Refresher.text: Reset the cooldown of all your abilities and restore all your charges.

Echo Shard.text:
Reset the cooldown of the imbued non-ultimate ability.

This item's cooldown is increased by the cooldown of the imbued ability.

Cheat Death.text:
When you would take lethal damage, instead become temporarily death immune and remove all non-stun debuffs.

While death immune, you deal reduced damage and have reduced healing.

Shadow Weave.text:
Become Stealthed. Whenever you take damage while Stealthed you get briefly revealed.
Attacking or using an ability will end your stealth and start an ambush, temporarily granting you bonus Weapon Damage and Spirit Power.

Majestic Leap.text:
Launch yourself high into the air and grant yourself a Barrier. While in the air, you can use the active again to drop down faster.

Cannot be used for 5s if attacked by enemy Hero.

Restorative Locket.text:
When an enemy uses an ability within 32mm range from you, store one Restoration Stack.

Consume all stacks to heal yourself and replenish up to 3 stamina based on how many stacks you have.

Healing Rite.text: Grant Regen and Sprint Speed to the target. Gets dispelled if you take damage from enemy players or objectives. Can be self-cast.

Shrink Ray.text: Reduces Model Size and grants Move Speed to the target. Allows usage of tunnels in this mode. Can be self-cast.

Infuser.text: Gain Spirit Lifesteal and Spirit Power.

Guardian Ward.text:
Provide the target with a Barrier and temporary Move Speed.
Can be self-cast.
Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else.

Divine Barrier.text:
Remove all non-stun debuffs from the target and provide them with a Barrier and Move Speed.
Can be self-cast. Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else.

Fleetfoot.text: Removes the Move Speed penalty while shooting.
Gain bonus Move Speed and Slow Resistance.

Kinetic Dash.text: When you Dash-Jump you gain Fire Rate and bonus Ammo until your next reload. Lasts up to 7s.

Arcane Surge.text: After you Dash-Jump, the next ability you use within 7s will have bonus Range, Duration, and Spirit Power.

Unstoppable.text:
Temporarily suppress negative status effects and become immune to Stun, Silence, Sleep, Root, and Disarm.
Cannot be used while Stunned or Slept.

Colossus.text:
Grow larger in size, gaining bullet resist, spirit resist, and melee damage.

Nearby enemies suffer from slow and have reduced dash speed.

Ethereal Shift.text: Instantly enter a void state and become Invulnerable for a short duration. Afterwards, gain a variety of temporary buffs:

Cursed Relic.text:
Curses an enemy - interrupting, Silencing, Disarming, and preventing item usage. Removes all non-ultimate buffs.

Your own Damage Output is reduced for the duration.

Duration Extender.text: Imbue an ability to increase its Duration.

Superior Duration.text: Increases the duration of your abilities and items.

Glass Cannon.text: Each hero kill grants permanent Fire Rate (up to a max of 8 times). Death results in the loss of 1 stack.

Fury Trance.text: Grants Fire Rate, Spirit Resistance and Move Speed, and removes the Move Speed penalty while shooting, but Silences you and disables stamina usage and regeneration.

Vampiric Burst.text: Grants Lifesteal, Fire Rate, and Ammo. This added Ammo is not limited by your max magazine size.

Lifestrike.text:
Your Melee Attack applies Movement Slow and heals you for a percentage of the Melee Damage dealt plus a fixed amount.

This heal is 40% effective vs non-heroes.
Cooldown is 1.5x as long for Light Melee hits.

Melee Charge.text: Your next Heavy Melee attack against an enemy deals increased damage.

Crushing Fists.text: Your next Heavy Melee attack against an enemy deals increased damage.

Your melee damage will restore ammo and apply a stacking bullet resist debuff on enemies. Heavy melee applies 2 stacks.

If the target reaches max stacks, they will be stunned.

Diviner's Kevlar.text: Upon casting an ultimate ability gain a Barrier and temporary Spirit Power.

Radiant Regeneration.text: While in-combat, Heal and gain bonus Movement Speed for a short duration when you cast an ability.

Burst Fire.text: Briefly gain Fire Rate and Move Speed when one of your bullets hits a hero.

Surge of Power.text: Imbue an ability with permanent Spirit Power. When that ability is used, gain bonus Move Speed and maintain full speed while attacking.

Intensifying Magazine.text: Increases Weapon Damage as you continuously fire your weapon.

Escalating Resilience.text: Grants Bullet Resist when your bullets hit a hero. Each shot can only grant one stack.

Veil Walker.text: Walking through a cosmic veil grants you Stealth, Heal and increased Move Speed.

Reactive Barrier.text: Gain a Barrier when you are Stunned, Chained, Immobilized, Slept or Silenced.

Indomitable.text: The next Stun, Chain, Immobilize, Sleep, Silence or Fear is automatically cleansed. When this happens, you gain a barrier and all your ability cooldowns get reduced by 20%.

Restorative Shot.text: Your next bullet will heal you based on what target you hit.

Split Shot.text:
Make your weapon fire multishot.

Hitting more than one Hero per attack will grant a stacking weapon damage bonus.

Targets can only be hit once per multishot.

Active Reload.text: While reloading, pressing Reload during the highlighted portion will instantly finish your reload and grant you Fire Rate, Bullet Lifesteal and Move Speed.

Magic Carpet.text:
Summon a Magic Carpet that will fly you away. While flying you are immune to slows and doing any action will dismiss the carpet.
Cannot use abilities while the carpet is being summoned.

Armor Piercer.text: Your Bullets have a chance to become unavoidable, piercing through enemies and ignoring their Bullet Resistance.

Infinite Rounds.text: Your Bullets have a chance to become unavoidable, piercing through enemies and ignoring their Bullet Resistance.

Juggernaut.text: Enemies that shoot you have their Fire Rate slowed.

Spellslinger.text:
While in-combat whenever you cast an ability or item, gain a stacking buff that improves fire rate and reload speed.
Each stack refreshes the duration.

Express Shot.text: Your next attack will fire twice in quick succession with increased damage and velocity. This attack consumes extra ammo.

Seraphim Wings.text: When Airborne, You deal more damage and take reduced damage. Allows unlimited Air Dash and Jumping.

Mystical Piano.text: After a short delay, enemies in the target area will be stunned and have their stamina depleted. After the stun they will be temporarily dazed.

Nullification Burst.text: Removes any positive buffs and prevents stamina usage and healing effects on enemies.

Celestial Blessing.text: Applies an extremely powerful cleanse that replenishes your allies globally.

Eternal Gift.text: Periodically gain a random permanent stat buff.
Reduces your next death's respawn timer.

Mystic Conduit.text: Provides yourself and allies with a powerful spirit focused aura. Has reduced values on allies.
Dealing significant Damage to an enemy Hero within 5s causes you to heal yourself and nearby allies.

Cloak of Opportunity.text: Block the next debuff that would apply movement lock, Stun, Chained, Immobilize, or Sleep and become Unstoppable. Also gain a Barrier and bonus move speed

Runed Gauntlets.text: Every time you land a heavy melee, your existing cooldowns get reduced.

Electric Slippers.text:
When sliding, evade bullets, gain fire rate and deal damage to enemies around you.

Cooldown is per target.

Prism Blast.text: You enter a void state and become untargetable and invincible for a short duration, during which lasers blast out and rotate around you.

Unstable Concoction.text: Consume a concoction that grants you Unstoppable and increased speed, health, spirit and weapon damage. After a short duration you die and explode, stunning nearby enemies and dealing damage based on your maximum health. Dying this way reduces your respawn time by 50%.

Frostbite Charm.text:
Imbued ability has its Cooldown reduced and gains Spirit Power. When the ability deals damage, freeze the target and apply bonus damage.

Cooldown is per target.

Shadow Strike.text: Go Invisible on Stamina use with no detection range. Doing a melee attack while invisible will cause you to steal bullet and spirit resistance from them and deal damage over time.

Ballistic Enchantment.text: Imbue an ability with increased range. Dealing damage with that ability grants you increased weapon damage per unique hero hit. Has reduced effect on non-heroes.

Golden Goose Egg.text:
Hatch the egg, gaining souls and permanent buffs.

The value of the egg grows the longer you hold onto it.

Gain a permanent buff per 80 Souls accrued when hatched.
